purpose: Can the actual P05 value model fit a fixed small diverse set, and what happens on controls held out from this new optimization? No new architecture or full-policy promotion.
model: Warm-start the retained selected P05 absolute/residual/logistic mixture, with all linear weight/bias parameters trainable. Frozen M01 contexts, existing39causal priority channels, original normalization and exact int64 anchor inputs. Original P05 probability arithmetic and integer MAP. No current/future argument input.
cohort: Fit: the128natural-TRAIN priority rows in frozen R02 fit indices. Same-fit-group control:128other natural priority rows from groups actually represented in those128, fixed seed20261120, excluding fit rows. Held-group control:128priority rows from R02 held_group indices, whose groups are disjoint from fit. Freeze row identities and support before optimization. This conditional diagnostic does not drop any row or category from the original benchmark.
exposure: Encoder, normalization, vocabulary/prior counts AND warm P05 head previously saw eligible TRAIN including control rows/groups. Controls are held out ONLY from new head optimization; not untouched full-policy/group generalization evidence.

training.loss: Mean normalized conditional integer NLL over all128fit rows per update. Different presentation/optimization from original full-data P05; capacity probe, not an isolated causal comparison to that training protocol.

checkpoint: Fixed final2000; assessments descriptive only. No DEV lookups/selection, early stopping, threshold tuning or promotion. Original full-DEV .0001/pat6/max35 rule remains unchanged for benchmark fits.
metrics: Exact integers, mean NLL and integer MAE/quantiles on fit and both controls
Rank among DISTINCT existing point/fallback-mode candidates, explicitly not full-Z rank

preflight: Before optimizer: exact integer-mode parity with retained G00/P05 TRAIN arguments and conditional-NLL difference<=2e-5 on all384cohort rows. Save raw outputs/checkpoint before checks. Reuse approved extraction evidence; no repeated495game audit.

diagnostic_fit_gate.qualification: Named finite-budget capacity criterion, not original success. Passing demonstrates small-set fitting only; failing does not prove a hard capacity limit or information insufficiency. Inspect support/gradients/optimization.

continuation: Fresh Solxhigh after this fit. If fitting succeeds but controls deteriorate, investigate representation/transfer and prior exposure. No architecture change or repeated seed automatically follows. Continuing research has no global cap.
integration: No complete-policy replacement in this diagnostic. Any later comparison must recompute normalized joint action/parameter probabilities and predicted families; cannot merely swap integers while inheriting old hard action choices.
constraints: EligibleTRAINonly. Both75game reservations sealed, DEVunopened by this probe. No matches/downloads/bot/runtime work/deployment. Original datasets, folds, checkpoints and all category/likelihood/three-seed targets preserved.
